name: Caliper
mission: Parametric CAD from photos and one measurement.
flowAlt: Data flow. Input: one to four photos named top, side and front, plus one known measurement such as hole spacing 40 mm; OpenCV segments each face and the reference sets millimetres per pixel, chained to the other views. Describe: the offline classical describer builds a feature tree of plate, fillet, flange, holes and slots; when an API key is set, Claude can describe the part instead, with the pixel measurements as evidence; dimensions are snapped to a 0.5 mm grid. Build: the tree becomes CadQuery code with named parameters, the solid is exported as STEP and STL, and a print check reports thin walls and overhangs.

nodes: view read from the file name
mm per px, chained across views
mesh kept for the print check
